{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Fire Ox''' (丁丑, ''hinoto ushi''; onyomi ''teichū'') is the 14th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 14th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Fire Rat|ja|丙子}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Earth Tiger|ja|戊寅}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''丁'' is Yin Fire, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''丑'' (Ox) is Yin Earth; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Fire Ox (丁丑)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): dīngchǒu
** Cantonese (Jyutping): ding1 cau2
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: hinoto-ushi
*** On'yomi: teichū
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): jeongchuk (정축)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Đinh Sửu

==Months of Yin Fire Ox==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 4 or 9 (i.e. when the Ten Heavenly Stems are {{ill|Kinoe (甲)|ja|甲|lt=Kinoe (甲)|2=ja|3=甲|4=zh|5=甲|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Jia}} or {{ill|Tsuchinoto (己)|ja|己|lt=Tsuchinoto (己)|2=ja|3=己|4=zh|5=己|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ji}}), the month of {{ill|December|en|December|qid=Q126|lt=December}} becomes the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of Teichuu. However, the term “month” here may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Japanese Lunisolar Calendar}} or to a seasonal month (from {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Minor Cold}} until the day before {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun}}) as applicable.
